wfsAnalyzer.title: Analyse layer
wfsAnalyzer.description: Checks whether a WFS is available for an active layer and analyses its attributes by count or area.
wfsAnalyzer.noActiveLayers: No subject data layer is currently switched on in the map. Add a layer via the topic tree.

unavailable.title: No WFS available
unavailable.noMetadata: No metadata is configured for this layer, so no download service can be determined. The layer cannot be analysed.
unavailable.noWfsInMetadata: The metadata record of this layer does not list a download service (WFS). The layer cannot be analysed.
unavailable.noMatchingFeatureType: The associated download service (WFS) contains no feature type for this layer. The layer cannot be analysed.
unavailable.ambiguousFeatureType: The download service (WFS) contains several feature types that could belong to this layer. As none of them can be identified with certainty, the layer is not analysed.

error.title: Check failed
error.text: The WFS availability could not be determined. The metadata or download service may currently be unreachable.

filter.valuesUnavailable: No value list available – please type the value.
filter.valuesLoadedPartly: Only the first {{count}} values are suggested – there are more. Please type values that are not listed.
filter.loadingValuesSlow: Loading values, this can take a moment on large layers.

mode.title: Result as
mode.noAreaAttribute: An area analysis needs an attribute holding the area size. This layer has none – counting still works.

analysis.attributesError: The attributes of the download service could not be loaded.
analysis.methodInfo: The classes come from the legend of the map service, so what is analysed is exactly what the map shows – including ranges that exist as no column. Where a feature falls into several classes, the one drawn last counts, as on the map. Features in no class are not drawn and not counted. Under “Advanced” a single attribute can be analysed instead.
analysis.attributeMatchesMap: Matches the colouring on the map.
analysis.manyFeatures: That is more than {{max}} features. Loading may take a while – consider restricting the analysis further.
analysis.needsAreaAttribute: Please choose the attribute holding the area size first.

result.title: Distribution of “{{attribute}}”
result.titleClasses: Distribution by the classes of the map
result.titleClassesInArea: Distribution by the classes of the map in {{area}}
result.groupedHint: Small categories are pooled into “Other”. The table shows every category.
